# Neomeditech Biomedical Solutions Pvt. Ltd.

> Leading medical equipment supplier, biomedical engineering, and clinical technology solutions in Nepal.

## Organization Overview
- **Legal Business Name**: Neomeditech Biomedical Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
- **Brand Names**: Neomeditech, Neomeditech Nepal
- **Headquarters**: Tarkeshwor-6, Kathmandu, Bagmati Province, Nepal
- **Coverage**: All 77 districts across Nepal (Kathmandu Valley, Pokhara, Chitwan, Biratnagar, Butwal, Nepalgunj, Dhangadhi, and nationwide)
- **Official Website**: https://www.neomeditech.com.np
- **Official Email**: contact.neomeditech@gmail.com
- **Official Contact Lines**: +977 9712011758, +977 9712011757
- **WhatsApp Support**: +977 9712011758

## Core Offerings & Medical Equipment
Neomeditech supplies hospital-grade, CE/ISO certified medical devices and clinical equipment to hospitals, clinics, diagnostic laboratories, nursing homes, and home-care patients:

1. **Respiratory & Critical Care**:
   - Oxygen Concentrators (5L, 10L medical grade)
   - BiPAP and CPAP machines & circuits
   - Ventilators and respiratory accessories
2. **Cardiology & Diagnostic Devices**:
   - Multi-parameter Patient Monitors & ICU Monitors
   - ECG Machines (12-lead digital electrocardiographs) & accessories
   - ABPM (24-Hour Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitors)
   - EEG Machines (Neurology diagnostics)
3. **Emergency & Life Support**:
   - Defibrillators & Automated External Defibrillators (AED)
   - Crash Carts & Emergency Trolleys
   - Infusion Pumps and Syringe Pumps
4. **Sterilization & Infection Control**:
   - Autoclave Machines (Vertical, Horizontal, Tabletop B-Class)
   - Door Gaskets and sterilization accessories
5. **Maternal & Neonatal Care**:
   - Radiant Baby Warmers & Phototherapy Units
   - CTG (Cardiotocography) Machines & Probes
   - Fetal Dopplers
6. **Surgical & Laboratory Equipment**:
   - Bipolar Electrosurgical Forceps & Cables
   - Laboratory Centrifuges & Colorimeters
   - Ultrasound & Sonography systems, probes, and accessories

## Biomedical Engineering Services
- **Biomedical Equipment Calibration & Testing**: Accurate clinical testing ensuring equipment meets healthcare safety regulations.
- **On-Site Installation & Staff Training**: Hands-on training for doctors, nurses, and technicians conducted by certified biomedical engineers.
- **Preventive Maintenance & Repair**: Rapid-response repair and periodic maintenance to minimize hospital downtime.
- **Warranty**: Comprehensive manufacturer warranty (1 to 2 years) backed by an in-house biomedical engineering service center in Kathmandu.
